    public interface Exportable
    Make a class representable in a JSON-like Data structure. Although nothing prevents complex objects to be included in the export, it is recommended to only include scalar / list / map values.

    The intent of this interface is to present instances of classes, objects or data to the user. This means that the export() method should not include private or confidential data. Be careful that sometimes, a superclass could include such information by default, it is thus necessary to override the parent implementation with your own.
